after: Cover crops, compost, deep mulch, and less tillage all feed that system. [University of Minnesota Extension, Soil Biology](https://extension.umn.edu/natural-resources/conservation/agricultural-soil-and-water/soil-biology) What none of them do is make a garden feed itself forever. Every harvest carries nutrients away in the food, and something has to put them back.
